  PROBLEM: _find_identity_role_goal_line_end_offset scans line-by-line, so wrapped Role/Goal paragraphs can cause `<identity-recall>` to be injected mid-paragraph instead of after the full opening paragraph.
  WHY: extract_identity_recall_metadata already accumulates wrapped paragraph lines correctly, and reviewers report the bug breaks prompts like mode-check-failure-triage.txt; severity disagreement: deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro rated MAJOR, the others rated BLOCKER.

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "the canonical renderer becomes the single source of truth, producing one correctly placed recall block with shell/Python parity and byte-stable flag-off output"
  expected_change_site: scripts/render_prompt.py:_find_identity_role_goal_line_end_offset
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]

- requirement: "Add a regression test for multi-line Role/Goal paragraphs so identity-recall injection cannot regress into inserting the block mid-paragraph."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py
  confidence=[5]

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/render_prompt.py:544-552 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The function does ROLE_GOAL_METADATA_PATTERN.fullmatch(line) on each individual stripped line, so multi-line Role/Goal paragraphs can be matched at the first line and the identity-recall block is injected mid-paragraph.
  WHY: extract_identity_recall_metadata at line 489 already handles paragraph accumulation, but the offset finder does not mirror that logic; with UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED=true the rendered prompt is corrupted.
- Requirement: "the canonical renderer becomes the single source of truth, producing one correctly placed recall block with shell/Python parity" (from linked issue #3681 and PR intent comment)
  Expected change site: scripts/render_prompt.py:_find_identity_role_goal_line_end_offset (must be rewritten to use paragraph accumulation matching extract_identity_recall_metadata), and tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py (needs a multi-line Role/Goal regression test)
  Evidence of absence: The offset finder at line 544 still uses line-by-line fullmatch instead of paragraph accumulation. The parity test test_render_prompt_py_matches_shell_identity_recall_output_with_default_persona only exercises mode-plan.txt which has a single-line Role/Goal paragraph. No test exercises a multi-line Role/Goal prompt like mode-check-failure-triage.txt.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/render_prompt.py:544-553 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The function uses `ROLE_GOAL_METADATA_PATTERN.fullmatch(line)` on each individual stripped line, which only matches when a single line contains the complete "Role: ... Goal: ..." pattern, so wrapped Role/Goal paragraphs are injected at the wrong location.
  WHY: When UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED=true and rendering a prompt with multi-line Role/Goal metadata, the offset finder cannot locate the paragraph end and corrupts the prompt output.
- Requirement: "the canonical renderer becomes the single source of truth, producing one correctly placed recall block with shell/Python parity and byte-stable flag-off output" (from linked issue #3681)
  Expected change site: scripts/render_prompt.py - _find_identity_role_goal_line_end_offset() should accumulate paragraph lines before matching (like the removed shell implementation did), and tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py should include a multi-line Role/Goal regression test
  Evidence of absence: The LAST RUN DIFF only modified test files to fix test environment inheritance. The core algorithmic bug in _find_identity_role_goal_line_end_offset() remains unfixed, and the existing test only covers mode-plan.txt which has single-line Role/Goal.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: Add a regression test for multi-line Role/Goal paragraphs (e.g., mode-check-failure-triage.txt) so the identity-recall injection cannot regress into inserting the block mid-paragraph.
  Expected change site: tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py - add test using prompts/mode-check-failure-triage.txt
  Evidence of absence: No test using mode-check-failure-triage.txt or any other multi-line Role/Goal prompt exists in the test file. The only identity-recall test uses mode-plan.txt which has single-line Role/Goal.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- Requirement:
Implement Phase B of #3627 by injecting identity recall blocks after prompt rendering so the canonical renderer becomes the single source of truth, producing one correctly placed recall block with shell/Python parity and byte-stable flag-off output.
  Expected change site:
scripts/render_prompt.py:apply_identity_recall_block() to correctly locate the paragraph end whose full concatenated lines match the Role: … Goal: … pattern and inject the identity recall block strictly after that paragraph.
  Evidence of absence:
_last_run_diff.patch_ shows render_prompt.py was edited to insert a new parses-then-injects identity-recall sequence, yet the paragraph-end logic remains unchanged. Packet at lines 544–558 (`_find_identity_role_goal_line_end_offset`) still attempts line-by-line `fullmatch` on the stripped line rather than accumulating the paragraph and matching against the concatenated text.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement:
Validate shell/Python renderer parity for prompts whose canonical personae metadata spans multiple lines.
  Expected change site:
tests/test_render_prompt_foundation.py: test_render_prompt_py_matches_shell_identity_recall_output_with_default_persona()
  Evidence of absence:
_original_pr_diff.patch_ shows the parity assertion was added to Python tests, yet the single existing parity test only exercises mode-plan.txt which has a single-line Role/Goal paragraph. It does not assert placement or block content versus any multi-line paragraph prompt.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
